fields.question: In the AD text file: the material of the affected structural part, exactly as the document states it (the most specific alloy/temper the text names for the cracked parts).
In the AD text file: the structural component where cracking was found, as named by the document.
In the AD text file: the failure mechanism the document reports (the kind of damage and its nature).
In the AD text file: the geometric feature the required inspections target (what detail of the part must be inspected).
In the AD text file: the class of corrective action the AD requires (for example: repetitive inspections, one-time inspection, replacement, modification). As stated by the document.

In the AD text file: does the document state that it supersedes or amends a previous AD or amendment? If yes, report the exact identifier(s) as printed; if the text contains no such statement, answer null.
